title: Rational coefficient comparison assembled from fraction maps
statement: Given the fraction maps supplied by the completed coefficient theorem, with zeroth leg the actual continuous ring inclusion, scalar recurrence, explicit module universal property and bundled pullback naturality, their natural transformation is colimiting and has the same pullback naturality. The coefficient field also satisfies the ring localization universal property against arbitrary ring objects on every scheme. This is only the rationalization clause of the comparison predicate, deduced from the specified module data.

source.place: Scalar sequence and ring structure paragraphs

proof.text: Use the scalar recurrence to construct NatTrans.ofSequence. Every cocone satisfies this recurrence by successor naturality, so the explicit module universal property gives the descent, factorization and uniqueness fields of IsColimit. Retain the supplied pullback-leg equations. Apply the scalar telescope ring theorem to its ring zeroth leg and invertible scalar.

proof_origin.place: Complete Lean construction from fraction maps and scalar telescope universal property.

mathlib_searches.query: universal property of localization of a ring object given by a scalar telescope of regular modules
mathlib_searches.verdict: Ordinary modules; no ring-object universal property in an arbitrary preadditive monoidal category.

mathlib_searches.query: colimit of regular module objects along multiplication by a natural number has the universal property of localization as a ring object
mathlib_searches.verdict: The scalar transitions are module maps, not ring maps, so ordinary ring-colimit results do not apply.

mathlib_searches.query: scalar_telescope_ring_universal; ring localization universal; telescope in Mathlib and both project roots
mathlib_searches.results: PadicIntegersInvertEll supplies module telescopes and comparisons with commutative colimit models; RingLocalizationSheafification supplies localization among commutative ring objects. Neither gives the required arbitrary ring-object test property from a module telescope.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Extract precisely the ring-structure argument missing from these APIs.

mathlib_searches.results: Existing coefficient fraction-map universal properties and the sequence natural-transformation constructor; combine these with the scalar ring universal property.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Reuse the existing fraction maps; this module is proved assembly, not a new admitted comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem sfb_rational_comparison_from_completed
    (ℓ : ℕ) (R K : Type) [CommRing R] [TopologicalSpace R] [IsTopologicalRing R]
    [CommRing K] [TopologicalSpace K] [IsTopologicalRing K]
    (φ : R →+* K) (hφ : Continuous φ)
    (h : ∃ j : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, ℕ →
      (Mod.regular ((completedCoefficient X (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheaf R)).X) ⟶
        ((Mod.comap (completedCoefficientMap X
          (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheafMap φ hφ)).hom).obj
        (Mod.regular (completedCoefficient X (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheaf K)).X))),
      (∀ X : Scheme.{u},
      IsIso (ℓ • 𝟙 ((completedCoefficient X (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheaf K)).X)) ∧
      (j X 0).hom = (completedCoefficientMap X
          (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheafMap φ hφ)).hom ∧
      (∀ n, ℓ • j X (n + 1) = j X n) ∧
      (∀ (B : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
          ((completedCoefficient X (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheaf R)).X))
        (b : ℕ → (Mod.regular
          (completedCoefficient X (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheaf R)).X ⟶ B)),
        (∀ n, ℓ • b (n + 1) = b n) →
        ∃! a : ((Mod.comap (completedCoefficientMap X
          (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheafMap φ hφ)).hom).obj
        (Mod.regular (completedCoefficient X (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheaf K)).X)) ⟶ B,
          ∀ n, j X n ≫ a = b n)) ∧
      (∀ (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ),
      (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).map (j Y n).hom ≫
          ((coefficientPullbackIso f
            (Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj K))).hom).hom =
        ((coefficientPullbackIso f
            (Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj R))).hom).hom ≫ (j X n).hom)) :
    ∃ ι : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, sfbRationalizationSequence ℓ R X ⟶
        (Functor.const ℕ).obj (sfbRationalCoefficientModule R K
          (fun Z ↦ completedCoefficientMap Z (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheafMap φ hφ)) X),
      (∀ X : Scheme.{u},
        ((ι X).app 0).hom = (completedCoefficientMap X
          (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheafMap φ hφ)).hom ∧
        Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (sfbRationalCoefficientModule R K
          (fun Z ↦ completedCoefficientMap Z (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheafMap φ hφ)) X)
          (ι X))) ∧
        IsIso (ℓ • 𝟙 (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj K) X))) ∧
      (∀ (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : ℕ),
        (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).map (((ι Y).app m).hom) ≫
            ((coefficientPullbackIso f
            (Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj K))).hom).hom =
          ((coefficientPullbackIso f
            (Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj R))).hom).hom ≫
            ((ι X).app m).hom) ∧
      (∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (B : Mon (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})),
        IsIso (ℓ • 𝟙 B.X) →
        ∀ a : coefficientRing X (Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj R)) ⟶ B,
          ∃! b : coefficientRing X (Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj K)) ⟶ B,
            completedCoefficientMap X
              (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheafMap φ hφ) ≫ b = a)
